What each service means

Short, plain definitions of the twenty services on this site, so you can compare quickly and ask for exactly what your clinic or business needs.

Dental Clinic Management Software

Software that runs a dental clinic day to day: appointments and chair schedules, patient dental records, treatment plans with estimates, billing and recall lists, all in one system.

Diagnostic Laboratory Management Software

Software that tracks a diagnostic lab from patient registration and test booking to sample tracking, verified results and branded printed reports, with daily collection and dues reports.

Hospital and Polyclinic Management Software

One shared system for multi doctor practices: OPD appointments and queues for every doctor, patient visit records, prescriptions, procedure scheduling, billing and a clean day summary.

Custom Business Software

Software built around how a specific business actually works, covering customers and records, billing and receipts, stock and inventory, staff and daily reports, instead of a generic tool.

Website Development

Designing and building a fast, mobile first website with clear service pages, booking and contact forms, a WhatsApp button, Google Maps and an SEO ready structure that search engines can read.

Shopify Development

Setting up and designing a Shopify store that sells properly: products and categories organised, a clean checkout, payment setup and WhatsApp ordering for customers who prefer chat.

Video Editing and Digital Marketing

Professional video editing with scripting, captions and branding, plus social media management, Google Ads and Meta Ads. Shooting is in Peshawar, editing only is available overall.

Clinic Software, Online and Offline

Every Nexa Studio software system works online and offline, both. Appointments, records and billing keep working during internet outages, and everything stays in one system.

SEO Services

Search engine optimisation for clinic and business websites: technical fixes, on-page optimisation of titles, headings and service pages, local search work and content improvements, so patients and customers find you on Google.

Branding, Logo and Graphic Design

Designing a logo and a complete brand identity, including colours, fonts and a simple style guide, plus graphic design for social media, print and packaging, so a clinic or business looks the same everywhere.

Mobile App Development

Building Android and iOS apps for clinics and businesses, such as appointment and booking apps for clinics and customer and ordering apps for shops and services, designed around the service they support.

Content Marketing and Copywriting

Written content that answers customer questions and supports search: SEO blog posts and articles, website and landing page copy, and product descriptions for online stores, in clear and simple language.

UI/UX Design

Interface and experience design for websites, software and apps: clear screens, simple user flows and wireframes, designed and checked on real phones so patients, customers and staff can use them easily.

Google Business Profile and Local SEO

Setting up and optimising a business profile on Google Search and Maps with the correct name, phone number, timings, categories, photos and services, plus local SEO so nearby customers find the business first.

AI Chatbots and Automation

Chatbots and simple automations that answer common questions and take enquiries when a team is busy or off duty: website chatbots, WhatsApp enquiry and booking flows, reminders and repeat workflow tasks.

CRM, ERP and POS Software

Named business systems alongside clinic software: CRM to track leads, patients and follow-ups, ERP to run stock, staff and daily operations, and POS for counter billing in shops and clinics.

Email Marketing

Email campaigns and follow-up flows that bring past patients and customers back: offers, reminders and newsletters, sent only to people who have agreed to receive them, with simple reports on opens and clicks.

WhatsApp and SMS Marketing

WhatsApp Business and SMS campaigns and automations: appointment reminders, offers, follow-up messages for enquiries and orders, and updates, sent to customers who have agreed to hear from the business.

TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube and LinkedIn Ads

Paid advertising beyond Google and Meta: campaigns on TikTok and Snapchat, video advertising on YouTube and ads on LinkedIn for professional audiences, with creative, targeting and reporting managed for the client.

Influencer and UGC Content

Creator and customer style content for clinics and brands: UGC style videos for ads and social media, influencer collaborations planned around a launch or offer, and short testimonial style videos filmed in real settings.

Amazon, Daraz and Noon Marketplace Management

Managing a seller store on Amazon, Daraz or Noon: store setup, product listings with titles, images and descriptions, marketplace campaign support, and stock and price updates, alongside the seller's own website or Shopify store.

SEO, AEO and GEO audit

SEO, AEO and GEO readiness report

What is implemented on this site, what was checked, and what still needs manual setup on the production domain. SEO covers search engines, AEO covers direct answers for answer engines and voice search, and GEO covers clear, quotable facts for AI search summaries. We do not promise first-page rankings: this site is built to genuine best practices and made technically ready for indexing.

Implemented

  • Unique page title and meta description with natural service and Peshawar terms
  • Semantic HTML with one H1 and ordered H2 and H3 headings
  • Canonical URL and index, follow robots directive
  • Open Graph and Twitter sharing metadata
  • JSON-LD structured data: ProfessionalService, WebSite and service catalog
  • Twenty dedicated service sections with descriptive anchor URLs and internal links
  • Descriptive image alt text, crawlable text and links without JavaScript
  • Consistent contact details for local SEO: Peshawar, Pakistan, 0347 9350215, 0311 5131931, afsaralamkhan72@gmail.com
  • AEO: FAQPage JSON-LD covering all 23 questions in the FAQ section, with answers that match the visible text
  • AEO: a short direct answer block at the top of each of the twenty dedicated service sections
  • AEO: Speakable structured data pointing voice assistants to the summary and direct answers
  • GEO: a factual studio summary with location, audience, software types, listed prices and contact in short quotable paragraphs
  • GEO: plain one paragraph definitions for all twenty services, plus trust signals an AI summary can verify: live portfolio links, printed prices and consistent contact details
  • Thirteen further services added across the services grid, service pages, definitions and FAQ

Checked

  • All internal section links and the seven live portfolio links
  • Mobile layout, tap targets and no horizontal scrolling
  • Animations respect reduced-motion settings and never hide content
  • Lightweight page: no heavy libraries, optimized images, system-efficient fonts
